code:
Want exactly B items selected (sum x_i = B)

penalty = P * (sum(x_i) - B)^2

zero when the constraint holds
strictly positive the moment it's violated
caption: Add P times this term to f(x) and the minimizer is steered toward constraint-satisfying solutions -- no explicit "subject to" clause needed.
